title: 教育与学习精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我能认出这个单词，但在说话时总是想不起来。
items.en: I recognise this word, but I can never recall it when I'm speaking.
answers: I recognise this word, but I can never recall it when I'm speaking.
I recognise this word, but I can never recall it when I am speaking.
items.notes: recognise 是看到后认得；recall 是主动回忆，区分两种学习能力。

items.zh: 你能示范一下如何把这个段落分成几个层次吗？
items.en: Could you show me how to break this paragraph into sections?
answers: Could you show me how to break this paragraph into sections?
items.notes: show sb how to do；break ... into ... 表示分成若干部分。

items.zh: 与其一次背二十遍，不如隔几天再复习。
items.en: Instead of memorising it twenty times in one sitting, try reviewing it again after a few days.
answers: Instead of memorising it twenty times in one sitting, try reviewing it again after a few days.
items.notes: instead of 后接动名词；try doing 表示尝试某种方法。

items.zh: 如果我先用自己的话解释，就更容易发现哪里没理解。
items.en: If I explain it in my own words first, I can more easily spot what I haven't understood.
answers: If I explain it in my own words first, I can more easily spot what I haven't understood.
If I explain it in my own words first, I can more easily spot what I have not understood.
items.notes: in my own words 表示用自己的话；spot 在此表示发现。

items.zh: 老师批注的那一段，正是我最没把握的部分。
items.en: The paragraph the teacher commented on is the part I was least confident about.
answers: The paragraph the teacher commented on is the part I was least confident about.
items.notes: 两处定语从句都省略了宾语关系代词；be confident about 表示对某事有把握。

items.zh: 自从开始记录常犯的错误，我就更容易在检查时发现它们。
items.en: Since I started keeping a record of recurring mistakes, I've found them easier to spot during revision.
answers: Since I started keeping a record of recurring mistakes, I've found them easier to spot during revision.
Since I started keeping a record of recurring mistakes, I have found them easier to spot during revision.
items.notes: keep a record of 表示记录；recurring 指反复出现的。

items.zh: 虽然这篇文章的生词不多，作者的论证却很难跟上。
items.en: Although this article contains few unfamiliar words, the author's argument is hard to follow.
answers: Although this article contains few unfamiliar words, the author's argument is hard to follow.
items.notes: few 表示数量少；follow an argument 表示跟上、理解论证。

items.zh: 我需要的不是更多练习题，而是对错误原因的解释。
items.en: What I need is not more exercises but an explanation of why my answers are wrong.
answers: What I need is not more exercises but an explanation of why my answers are wrong.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；why 从句说明 explanation 的内容。

items.zh: 交作业之前，请检查每个代词指代的是谁或什么。
items.en: Before handing in your work, check who or what each pronoun refers to.
answers: Before handing in your work, check who or what each pronoun refers to.
items.notes: hand in 表示提交；refer to 表示指代，间接疑问使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 小组讨论结束后，每个人都要总结另一个人的观点。
items.en: After the group discussion, everyone has to summarise another person's point of view.
answers: After the group discussion, everyone has to summarise another person's point of view.
items.notes: everyone 作单数主语；summarise 表示概括，而非逐字重复。

items.zh: 如果我当时问清了题目要求，就不会写偏题。
items.en: If I'd clarified the task requirements, I wouldn't have written off topic.
answers: If I'd clarified the task requirements, I wouldn't have written off topic.
If I'd clarified the task requirements, I would not have written off topic.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件句反思已发生的事情；write off topic 表示写偏题。

items.zh: 试着把新学的表达放进一个与你生活有关的句子里。
items.en: Try using the new expression in a sentence related to your own life.
answers: Try using the new expression in a sentence related to your own life.
items.notes: try doing 表示尝试；related to 是过去分词短语，修饰 sentence。

items.zh: 我能在考试前借用上学期的试卷吗？
items.en: Could I borrow last term's exam paper before the test?
answers: Could I borrow last term's exam paper before the test?
items.notes: borrow：借入。

items.zh: 这门课要求先学过基础统计。
items.en: This course requires prior study of basic statistics.
answers: This course requires prior study of basic statistics.
items.notes: prior study：事先学过。

items.zh: 我漏听了最后一步，能从那里再讲一次吗？
items.en: I missed the final step; could you explain it again from that point?
answers: I missed the final step; could you explain it again from that point?
items.notes: miss 在此表示未听到。

items.zh: 请先独立作答，再和同桌比较答案。
items.en: Answer on your own first, then compare your answers with a partner.
answers: Answer on your own first, then compare your answers with a partner.
items.notes: on your own：独立完成。

items.zh: 我们需要交纸质版，还是电子版就可以？
items.en: Do we need to submit a printed copy, or is a digital version enough?
answers: Do we need to submit a printed copy, or is a digital version enough?
items.notes: printed copy：纸质版。

items.zh: 我把引用出处记在另一页了。
items.en: I noted the source of the quotation on a separate page.
answers: I noted the source of the quotation on a separate page.
items.notes: source of a quotation：引用出处。

items.zh: 这个定义和上一章的定义有什么区别？
items.en: How does this definition differ from the one in the previous chapter?
answers: How does this definition differ from the one in the previous chapter?
items.notes: one 代指 definition。

items.zh: 我能用自己的例子来解释这个概念吗？
items.en: May I use my own example to explain this concept?
answers: May I use my own example to explain this concept?
items.notes: may I：礼貌征求允许。

items.zh: 录音太快了，我需要先把播放速度降下来。
items.en: The recording is too fast for me, so I need to slow it down first.
answers: The recording is too fast for me, so I need to slow it down first.
items.notes: slow it down：降低速度。

items.zh: 我总是把这两个发音相近的词弄混。
items.en: I keep confusing these two words because they sound similar.
answers: I keep confusing these two words because they sound similar.
items.notes: confuse：混淆。

items.zh: 只有看到上下文，我才能判断这里的词义。
items.en: I can work out the meaning here only when I see the context.
answers: I can work out the meaning here only when I see the context.
items.notes: work out：推断、弄清。

items.zh: 这次我想先列提纲，再开始写正文。
items.en: This time I want to make an outline before writing the main text.
answers: This time I want to make an outline before writing the main text.
items.notes: make an outline：列提纲。

items.zh: 开头提出的问题，在结尾还没有得到回应。
items.en: The question raised in the introduction remains unanswered in the conclusion.
answers: The question raised in the introduction remains unanswered in the conclusion.
items.notes: remain unanswered：仍未回应。

items.zh: 你这一段同时讨论了两个不同的问题，读者可能不容易跟上。
items.en: This paragraph discusses two separate issues at once, which may confuse the reader.
answers: This paragraph discusses two separate issues at once, which may confuse the reader.
items.notes: at once：同时。

items.zh: 我需要确认这个表达是否适合正式写作。
items.en: I need to check whether this expression suits formal writing.
answers: I need to check whether this expression suits formal writing.
items.notes: suit：适合。

items.zh: 背单词时，我会把重音位置也标出来。
items.en: When learning vocabulary, I mark the position of the stress as well.
answers: When learning vocabulary, I mark the position of the stress as well.
items.notes: stress 在这里指单词重音。

items.zh: 这张卡片正面是问题，背面是答案。
items.en: The question is on the front of this card, and the answer is on the back.
answers: The question is on the front of this card, and the answer is on the back.
items.notes: front 与 back 对应正反面。

items.zh: 上次我只是猜对了，这次想弄清楚理由。
items.en: Last time I only guessed correctly; this time I want to understand why.
answers: Last time I only guessed correctly; this time I want to understand why.
items.notes: why 在句末省略已知内容。

items.zh: 如果今天学不完，我会把剩下的内容安排到明天。
items.en: If I cannot finish today, I will schedule the remaining material for tomorrow.
answers: If I cannot finish today, I will schedule the remaining material for tomorrow.
If I can't finish today, I'll schedule the remaining material for tomorrow.
items.notes: schedule ... for：安排到某时。

items.zh: 图书馆的那本参考书已经被借走了。
items.en: The reference book in the library has already been borrowed.
answers: The reference book in the library has already been borrowed.
items.notes: 现在完成时被动说明当前状态。

items.zh: 你在演示时用了太多缩写，听众可能不熟悉。
items.en: You used many abbreviations in the presentation that the audience may not know.
answers: You used many abbreviations in the presentation that the audience may not know.
items.notes: abbreviation：缩写。

items.zh: 我希望反馈能指出优先修改哪一处。
items.en: I would like the feedback to identify which part I should revise first.
answers: I would like the feedback to identify which part I should revise first.
I'd like the feedback to identify which part I should revise first.
items.notes: would like sth to do：希望反馈起某作用。

items.zh: 学习小组约定，每个人都要带来一个尚未解决的问题。
items.en: Our study group agreed that everyone would bring an unresolved question.
answers: Our study group agreed that everyone would bring an unresolved question.
items.notes: would 是过去语境中的将来。

items.zh: 完成练习后，我会合上笔记，看看还能记住多少。
items.en: After finishing an exercise, I close my notes to see how much I can recall.
answers: After finishing an exercise, I close my notes to see how much I can recall.
items.notes: recall：主动回忆。
